summary: Three tests were stale relative to already-accepted B860/B863 production behavior and were updated to match current code; no production runtime file was modified.

fixes.before: asserted `not workspace.path.exists()` after a claim_ownership_lost finalize
fixes.reason: B860/B863 changed ProcessManager._finalize_isolated_request (process_launcher.py:2385-2715) to set cleanup=False on every WorkspaceError terminal path, including claim_ownership_lost, because a lost-claim read can be a false positive and deleting the workspace destroys evidence and forces needless reruns. The test still asserted the old delete-on-loss behavior.

fixes.before: read_text() on scripts/aiworkhub-task-reconciler.service, a systemd unit file that does not exist anywhere in this worktree (verified: no *reconciler*.service file under tools/geoai-task-mcp/)
fixes.after: replaced with test_daemon_writes_lifecycle_transitions_with_writes_enabled, which drives task_reconciler.run_scan() with AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES=1 and asserts the actual lifecycle write (review_ready) the old test's docstring claimed to cover
fixes.reason: The product never ships that unit file at that path; the test asserted an artifact the product never ships, per acceptance criteria.

fixes.after: returns [] when status is None before touching .upper()
fixes.reason: DashboardProvider.get_cost_ledger (dashboard.py:484) calls task_store.list_tasks(self.repo_root, status=None, limit=5000) to scan the full task store -- a currently-shipped optional status argument the fake did not support, crashing with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'upper'. Fix supports status=None without relaxing the test's forbidden_legacy_provider / task_store-only call restrictions.

validation.pytest: cd tools/geoai-task-mcp && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_process_launcher_security.py tests/test_task_liveness_reconciler.py tests/test_dashboard.py
